# commercetools_discount_group (Resource)

A Discount Group combines Cart Discounts that are applied as one: the group has one sort order, and only its best Cart Discount applies to a Cart. Cart Discounts join a group through `discount_group_id` on `commercetools_cart_discount`.

See also the [Discount Groups API documentation](https://docs.commercetools.com/api/projects/discount-groups).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "commercetools_discount_group" "summer_sale" {
  key        = "summer-sale"
  sort_order = "0.6"
  name = {
    en = "Summer sale"
  }
}

# Only the best discount of the group applies to a cart.
resource "commercetools_cart_discount" "ten_percent" {
  name = {
    en = "Ten percent off"
  }
  predicate         = "1 = 1"
  discount_group_id = commercetools_discount_group.summer_sale.id
  target {
    type      = "lineItems"
    predicate = "1 = 1"
  }
  value {
    type      = "relative"
    permyriad = 1000
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `key` (String) User-defined unique identifier of the DiscountGroup.
- `sort_order` (String) A decimal between 0 and 1, such as `"0.5"`, that orders the group among other groups and Cart Discounts; a higher value applies first. It must be unique among Cart Discounts and Discount Groups.

### Optional

- `description` (Map of String) Description of the DiscountGroup as localized string.
- `is_active` (Boolean) Whether the group's Cart Discounts are considered at all. Defaults to `true`.
- `name` (Map of String) Name of the DiscountGroup as localized string.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Platform-generated unique identifier of the DiscountGroup.
- `version` (Number) Current version of the DiscountGroup.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# A discount group is imported using its id.
terraform import commercetools_discount_group.summer_sale 2a46d6d6-5da2-4c4f-9bd6-7a0a1e9a6c1f
```
